concept.reason: Direct reference imagery and taxon-specific sources sufficient for original silhouette; no extra concept image.

scope: Original Compsognathus longipes living stylization guided by a Paris fossil photograph and historical German specimen drawing; not a specimen scan or exact individual restoration.

scientific_limits.en: Three-dimensional body breadth, complete skull outline, soft tissue, covering, color and posture are inferred. The Paris photograph shows only part of the slab; the German image is a historical interpretive drawing, not a photograph or current anatomical authority. The 0.9 m length is an artistic estimate, not a measured specimen or maturity claim.
scientific_limits.zh: 三维体宽、完整头骨轮廓、软组织、体表覆盖、颜色及姿态为推断。巴黎照片仅显示部分石板；德国图像是历史解释性绘图，并非照片或现行解剖权威。0.9米体长为艺术估值，不是标本实测值，也不主张成熟阶段。

taxon_scope: Compsognathus longipes, genus inventory identity retained

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic envelope; not equated to NHM generic0.7m or either fossil measurement.

shape_requirements: Original thin muzzle, elongate trunk and disproportionately long hindfeet must all remain recognizable.
Slim low snout, light neck, elongated narrow torso and long tapering balancing tail; no bulky large-theropod head.
Long metatarsal region and long narrow three-toed supporting feet clearly separate from shin and thigh.
Small forelimbs kept inward-facing rather than palms-down; no crest or exaggerated grasping sickle claw.
construction_notes: Avoid enlarging the torso to generic dinosaur proportions; inspect side gray silhouette for long trunk and hindfeet.
Use simple restrained body surface; neither absence nor presence of a specific feather pattern is established by these references.
Do not copy fossil death pose, displaced jaws or missing tail tip; conservative living reconstruction is explicit.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: thin muzzle, elongate trunk and disproportionately long hindfeet. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：纤细吻、伸长躯干与比例较长的后足。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block thin muzzle, elongate trunk and disproportionately long hindfeet with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织纤细吻、伸长躯干与比例较长的后足；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
